items.title: ExBeta Documentation
items.text:
Welcome to the ExBeta Luau environment reference.

ExBeta is a Roblox script executor providing a comprehensive API for manipulating game state, inspecting runtime internals, and extending client capabilities beyond standard scripting constraints.

items.title: Quick Start
items.text:
-- Load and run code
local fn = loadstring("return workspace.Name")
print(fn()) -- Workspace

-- Hook a function
local old
old = hookfunction(print, function(...)
    old("[HOOKED]", ...)
end)

print("test") -- [HOOKED] test

-- Read a file
local config = readfile("config.json")
print(config)

-- Make an HTTP request
local data = HttpGet("https://api.example.com/data")
print(data)

items.title: About ExBeta
items.text: ExBeta is a Roblox script executor designed for developers who need low-level control over game state and runtime behavior.

items.title: Features
items.text:
• Function Manipulation — Hook, clone, and inspect functions at runtime.
  • Metatable Control — Read and modify protected metatables.
  • Debug Introspection — Access upvalues, constants, prototypes, and the call stack.
  • Filesystem Access — Read and write files in a sandboxed workspace.
  • Networking — HTTP requests and WebSocket connections.
  • Cryptography — Hash, encrypt, compress, and encode data.
  • Drawing API — Render 2D overlays on the game viewport.
  • Input Simulation — Programmatic keyboard and mouse control.
  • Script Analysis — Inspect loaded scripts and their bytecode.
  • Signal Control — Fire and intercept Roblox signals.

items.title: request
items.text:
Performs a fully configurable HTTP request.

request(options: table): table

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description options.Url string Target URL. Required. options.Method string One of GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS. options.Headers table Optional map of string headers. Content-Length cannot be set. options.Cookies table Optional map of string cookies. options.Body string Optional body. Not allowed for GET and HEAD.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table Response table described below.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local response = request({
    Url = "https://api.example.com/users",
    Method = "POST",
    Headers = {
        ["Content-Type"] = "application/json",
    },
    Body = '{"name":"exbeta"}',
})

if type(response) == "table" then
    print(response.StatusCode, response.StatusMessage)
    print(response.Body)
end

items.text:

Function Description Regex.new Compiles a regular expression. Regex:Match Finds the first match and returns its captures. Regex:MatchMany Finds all matches and returns their captures. Regex:Replace Replaces every match with the replacement string. Regex.Escape Escapes special regex characters so the string matches literally.

items.title: Regex.Escape
items.text:
Escapes special regex characters so the string matches literally.

Regex.Escape(text: string): string

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description text string The string to escape.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description string Escaped pattern.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local literal = Regex.Escape("a.b")
print(literal) -- a\.b

items.title: Regex:Match
items.text:
Finds the first match and returns its captures.

regex:Match(text: string): table?

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description text string The string to search.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table? Array of captures { Full, Groups = {...} }, or nil when no match.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local match = regex:Match("abc123")
if match then
    print(match.Full) -- 123
end

items.title: Regex:MatchMany
items.text:
Finds all matches and returns their captures.

regex:MatchMany(text: string): table

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description text string The string to search.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table Array of match tables, each with Full and Groups.

items.title: Example
items.text:
for _, match in ipairs(regex:MatchMany("1 and 2 and 3")) do
    print(match.Full)
end

items.title: Regex.new
items.text:
Compiles a regular expression.

Regex.new(pattern: string, flags: string?): Regex

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description pattern string ECMAScript regex pattern. flags string? Optional flags: i for case-insensitive, m for multiline.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description Regex Compiled regex object.

items.title: Example
items.text: local regex = Regex.new("\\d+", "i")

items.title: Regex:Replace
items.text:
Replaces every match with the replacement string.

regex:Replace(text: string, replacement: string): string

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description text string The source string. replacement string Replacement text, which can reference captures with $1, $2.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description string Result with all matches replaced.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local result = regex:Replace("hello world", "goodbye")
print(result)

items.title: Script
items.text: tags: - Script

items.title: Script
items.text:
Inspect scripts, their bytecode and environments.

Function Description getscripts Returns all client-side scripts currently loaded. getrunningscripts Returns scripts that have started execution. getloadedmodules Returns every ModuleScript that has been required. getscriptbytecode Returns the compiled bytecode of a script. getscriptfromthread Returns the script that owns a coroutine. getscriptclosure Returns a callable closure for a script's body. getcallingscript Returns the script that invoked the current function. getsenv Returns the environment table of a running script. getgc Scans the garbage collector for live objects. getallthreads Returns all live coroutines. filtergc Filters garbage-collected objects by type and criteria.

items.title: filtergc
items.text:
Filters garbage-collected objects by type and criteria.

filtergc(filter: string, args: table, returnOne: boolean?): any

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description filter string Object type to filter, such as "function" or "table". args table Criteria map; keys depend on the filter. returnOne boolean? Return the first match instead of an array.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description any Matched object, or an array of matches.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local matches = filtergc("function", {
    Hash = "a1b2c3",
})
print(#matches)

items.title: getallthreads
items.text:
Returns all live coroutines.

getallthreads(): table

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table Array of threads.

items.title: Example
items.text:
for _, thread in ipairs(getallthreads()) do
    print(thread)
end

items.title: getcallingscript
items.text:
Returns the script that invoked the current function.

getcallingscript(): Instance?

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description Instance? The calling script, or nil.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local script = getcallingscript()
print(script and script.Name)

items.title: getgc
items.text:
Scans the garbage collector for live objects.

getgc(includeTables: boolean?): table

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description includeTables boolean? Include tables as well as other types.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table Array of garbage-collected objects.

items.title: Example
items.text:
for _, value in ipairs(getgc(true)) do
    if typeof(value) == "function" then
        print(value)
    end
end

items.title: getloadedmodules
items.text:
Returns every ModuleScript that has been required.

getloadedmodules(): table

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table Array of loaded module instances.

items.title: Example
items.text:
for _, module in ipairs(getloadedmodules()) do
    print(module:GetFullName())
end

items.title: getrunningscripts
items.text:
Returns scripts that have started execution.

getrunningscripts(): table

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table Array of running script instances.

items.title: Example
items.text:
for _, script in ipairs(getrunningscripts()) do
    print(script.Name)
end

items.title: getscriptbytecode
items.text:
Returns the compiled bytecode of a script.

getscriptbytecode(script: Instance): string

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description script Instance A LocalScript, ModuleScript or Script.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description string The bytecode, or an empty string when unavailable.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local bytecode = getscriptbytecode(script)
print(#bytecode)

items.title: getscriptclosure
items.text:
Returns a callable closure for a script's body.

getscriptclosure(script: Instance): function?

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description script Instance The script to wrap.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description function? The closure, or nil when unavailable.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local closure = getscriptclosure(script)
if closure then
    closure()
end

items.title: getscriptfromthread
items.text:
Returns the script that owns a coroutine.

getscriptfromthread(thread: thread): Instance?

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description thread thread The coroutine to inspect.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description Instance? The owning script, or nil.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local thread = coroutine.running()
local script = getscriptfromthread(thread)
print(script and script.Name)

items.title: getscripts
items.text:
Returns all client-side scripts currently loaded.

getscripts(): table

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table Array of script instances.

items.title: Example
items.text:
for _, script in ipairs(getscripts()) do
    print(script:GetFullName())
end

items.title: getsenv
items.text:
Returns the environment table of a running script.

getsenv(script: Instance): table?

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description script Instance The script to inspect.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table? The script environment, or nil.

items.title: Example

local env = getsenv(script)
print(env)

items.title: Signals
items.text:
Inspect and fire connections and game signals.

Function Description getconnections Returns all connections attached to a signal. getconnection Returns a single connection by index. firesignal Fires all connections attached to a signal. defersignal Fires a signal at the end of the current scheduler step. replicatesignal Fires a signal and replicates the result to the server. fireproximityprompt Triggers a ProximityPrompt as though it were used. fireclickdetector Triggers a ClickDetector as though it were clicked. firetouchinterest Simulates a touch between two parts. setproximitypromptduration Sets the hold duration of a ProximityPrompt. getproximitypromptduration Returns the hold duration of a ProximityPrompt. getsignalwhitelist Returns the allowlist of signals that may be replicated. cansignalreplicate Checks whether a signal can be replicated to the server. getsignalargumentsinfo Returns argument metadata for a signal. getsignalarguments Returns the argument list of a signal. getrendersteppedlist Returns the current list of RenderStepped connections.

items.title: WebSocket
items.text: tags: - WebSocket

items.title: WebSocket
items.text:
Open WebSocket connections from the client.

Function Description WebSocket.connect Opens a WebSocket connection and returns a client object. WebSocket.OnMessage Fires whenever a message arrives. WebSocket.OnClose Fires when the connection closes. WebSocket.Send Sends a text message over the socket. WebSocket.Close Closes the connection.

items.title: WebSocket.Close
items.text:
Closes the connection.

ws:Close(): ()

items.title: Example
items.text: ws:Close()

items.title: WebSocket.connect
items.text:
Opens a WebSocket connection and returns a client object.

WebSocket.connect(url: string): table

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description url string ws:// or wss:// endpoint.

items.title: Returns
items.text: Type Description table Client with the OnMessage, OnClose, Send and Close fields.

items.title: Example
items.text:
local ws = WebSocket.connect("wss://echo.example.com")

ws.OnMessage:Connect(function(message)
    print("received:", message)
end)

ws.OnClose:Connect(function()
    print("closed")
end)

ws:Send("hello")

items.title: WebSocket.OnClose
items.text:
Fires when the connection closes.

ws.OnClose:Connect(function())

items.title: Example
items.text:
ws.OnClose:Connect(function()
    print("connection closed")
end)

items.title: WebSocket.OnMessage
items.text:
Fires whenever a message arrives.

ws.OnMessage:Connect(function(message: string))

items.title: Members
items.text: Name Type Description message string The incoming payload.

items.title: Example
items.text:
ws.OnMessage:Connect(function(message)
    print(message)
end)

items.title: WebSocket.Send
items.text:
Sends a text message over the socket.

ws:Send(message: string): ()

items.title: Parameters
items.text: Name Type Description message string The payload to send.

items.title: Example
items.text: ws:Send("ping")
